vae_objective: Gaussian decoder negative ELBO up to an additive constant; six-dimensional diagonal-Gaussian posterior; beta=1
vae_sampler: one prior draw and one decoder evaluation
architecture_comparison: flow and diffusion compare a two-hidden-layer tanh MLP with a single linear layer under matched regression settings; VAE uses a two-hidden-layer encoder/decoder and the same epoch, batch, learning-rate, and device policy
metric_scope: All distributional metrics are computed in the declared training-fitted whitened PCA space; frechet_latent is not image-feature FID.
